Working with Jeremy was such a pleasure.  We had several bids done and aside from the fact he was the lowest price, he was the ONLY one who was giving us what we wanted.  He stood in our space and saw how it flowed and made suggestions we just loved.  He also got excited when I showed him some glass I was hoping to use in a couple doors.  Another company (larger and more known) said they couldn't work with them.  Jeremy said he enjoys doing something a little different when he has the chance!   I even had enough for a linen cabinet in my bath that I just love.    He is polite, has great communication and affordable!

You'll love working with him!
